prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one realistic miniature building icon for the WWII strategy game 山河远征录, matching the fidelity of its existing premium player-city miniature art.
Primary request: create a finely detailed architectural scale-model render of ONE functional building or compact facility compound, not a whole city. Realistic architecture, physically credible construction and tactile materials, rich three-dimensional architectural relief, deep recessed windows, individual roof tiles or corrugated sheet ribs, believable wall thickness, gutters, doors, paving joints and restrained functional props. Sophisticated photoreal miniature model craftsmanship, crisp all-in-focus rendering, realistic ambient occlusion and soft shadows.
Composition: square image; consistent elevated three-quarter isometric camera approximately 35 degrees above the horizon, front and right sides visible, near-orthographic perspective. Building or facility occupies 75-82 percent of the frame. Entire object and all attached facilities fully visible, minimum 9 percent margin. One coherent compact plot with shallow ground treatment, no thick pedestal or floating cut-earth block. Main architectural mass dominates; props and small plants support scale without obscuring it. Readable silhouette at 64-96 px while roof and facade detail rewards 256 px viewing.
Lighting: natural soft daylight from upper left, balanced warm highlights and cool soft shadows; matching exposure and camera across the collection, no nighttime or dramatic smoke.
Background: clean pale warm gray seamless background with a subtle contact shadow; no horizon, surrounding scenery or graphic frame. Keep the plot edge legible for later background preparation. Do not simulate transparency with a checkerboard.
Constraints: 1930s-1940s built environment with game-friendly alternate-history artistic interpretation. No typography, names, logos, badges, floating resource symbols, watermarks, neon, futuristic equipment, modern skyscrapers, fantasy architecture, toy-like plastic, low-poly geometry, flat vector shapes, cell shading or comic outlines. No giant thematic props substituted for the actual architecture. Vehicles must be smaller than the building and from the period. No excessive shallow depth of field.

Collection direction: A realistic Burma Road forward base in the 1940s: weathered warm plaster, local dark stone, timber bracing, gray clay tiles, subdued olive painted corrugated metal and canvas. Modest practical construction, red-earth verges, natural tropical grasses and sparse small trees. Operational and maintained, with subtle wear, no battle ruins. Civic buildings remain masonry and industrial facilities remain industrial.

Subject / 市政厅: A substantial civic headquarters: symmetrical two-story cream masonry wings, columned main entrance, broad stairs, terracotta hipped roofs, a restrained clock tower and small weathered green copper cupola, a compact paved courtyard and two garden beds. Administrative building dominates.
